_comment: Wakil config — copy to ~/.config/wakil/config.json and edit. Precedence: defaults < config file < env < flags. Every field below is OPTIONAL unless marked '(required)'; unset fields use the built-in defaults shown in internal/config/config.go DefaultConfig().
_comment_sandbox: Sandbox image resolution: --sandbox-image flag > WAKIL_IMAGE env > sandbox.image (this file) > legacy top-level "image" > the digest-pinned image built into release binaries > (dev builds only) the unpinned local image "wakil-dev" with a warning. Leave unset to use the image your wakil release was published with.
_comment_sandbox_backend: sandbox.backend selects where tool calls run: "hisn" (github.com/treeol/hisn, rootless), "docker" or "direct" (no sandbox, host execution). LEAVE IT UNSET to get the default: hisn when no backend is chosen anywhere, hisn >= 0.4.2 is in PATH and `hisn check` passes, otherwise docker (the startup banner says why). Setting it pins the choice ("docker" keeps Docker even where hisn is usable). The old top-level exec_mode (docker|direct) is a deprecated alias that prints a warning. An unknown value is an error; there is never a fallback to docker or to running unsandboxed. sandbox.hisn.* applies to hisn only. See docs/sandbox-backends.md.
_comment_docker: Docker sandbox hardening. --cap-drop=ALL + --read-only + --security-opt=no-new-privileges are always applied. docker_caps re-adds specific caps if the toolchain needs them (e.g. ["CHOWN"] if go build fails). docker_memory and docker_pids_limit set resource ceilings. docker_tmpfs_size sets the /tmp tmpfs size — must be coherent with docker_memory (tmpfs pages count against the container memory cgroup).
_comment_subagents: Subagent dispatch: dispatch_subagent spawns a read-only discovery worker. dispatch_subagents fans out several in parallel. max_parallel_subagents bounds concurrency. subagent_endpoint / subagent_backend route children to a different endpoint or backend than the parent.
_comment_costs: Per-source pricing for the cost-tracking sidebar. Unpriced sources show '—', not '$0.00'. inference is a single rate over local proxy tokens (compute estimate). inference_backends holds real per-token rates for external providers routed through the proxy. mashura is keyed by oracle model ID.
_comment_mashura: Counsel: second opinions from external models. oracle_enabled gates the tools. mashura_panels defines named model groups; mashura_tool_panels maps each tool to a panel. Keys are read at call time from env vars, never stored here.
_comment_mashura_models: Per-model reviewer limits, keyed by 'provider:model' or the bare model id. context_tokens overrides the built-in/OpenRouter context window; review_max_tokens is the answer budget (never below 4096 for a review). reasoning sets the per-model reasoning/thinking budget for reviewer calls to this model — max_tokens on the wire is additive (reasoning budget + answer budget); the answer budget is never reduced. A document that does not fit is sent in labelled parts or the call fails — it is never truncated.
_comment_mashura_roles: Per-role overrides for Mashūra counsel reasoning, keyed by role name ('reviewer' or 'check'). When a role's reasoning is set, it applies to all calls dispatched under that role. Per-model reasoning (in mashura_models above) takes precedence for the reviewer role. For the check role, the role-level setting is the only source. Example: "mashura_roles": {"reviewer": {"reasoning": {"effort": "medium", "max_tokens": 4096}}, "check": {"reasoning": {"effort": "low"}}}
_comment_reasoning_defaults: Built-in reasoning defaults when no explicit setting is configured: main model = medium, Mashūra reviewer = medium (max_tokens 8192), Mashūra check = none (disabled), subagent = low. Use /thinking off or --think off to explicitly disable. See docs/configuration.md.
_comment_mashura_server_tools: OpenRouter server-side tools (per-panel). Enable with server_tools in a named panel, e.g. ["openrouter:web_search", "openrouter:web_fetch"]. The model decides when to call them; OpenRouter executes server-side. web_search_engine: auto|native|exa|firecrawl|parallel|perplexity. server_tool_max_calls: 0=OpenRouter default (30). Briefing content may be sent to third-party search engines.
_comment_lsp: Language-server-backed code intelligence. Off by default. lsp_servers maps a language to a server; built-in defaults exist for go (gopls), rust (rust-analyzer), python (pyright-langserver), typescript/javascript (typescript-language-server), and c/cpp (clangd). All ship in the default wakil-dev sandbox image.
_comment_style_guides: Optional language-specific coding guidance. Disabled by default. Embedded guides: go, python, typescript, javascript. style_guide_paths replaces a built-in or adds a custom language; files are read on the host once at startup. Relative paths resolve beside this config file; ~/ is expanded. Custom key 'rs' matches .rs paths and the name rs. Maximum two active guides and 4096 rendered bytes.
_comment_browser: Headless-browser tools (chromedp + Chromium) for visual verification, DOM inspection, interaction testing. Off by default. Requires chromium in the sandbox image (included in the default Dockerfile). Set browser_path to a specific Chromium binary when it's not in PATH (e.g. on a bare host).
_comment_mcp: MCP tool servers. Each entry is a named server with stdio or http transport. Tools appear automatically when configured.
_comment_search: Native web search. SearXNG (self-hosted) or Google Custom Search. Both built-in — no external binaries.
_comment_context: Context window management. Absolute byte limits (fallback) and relative fractions (override when n_ctx is known). tool_result_cap limits per-result bytes kept in context; turn_tool_budget is the per-turn cumulative budget.
_comment_clipboard: TUI copy transport: auto (try native clipboard tools wl-copy/xclip/xsel/pbcopy/clip.exe, then OSC 52 fallback) | native (never emit OSC 52) | osc52 (never run a local clipboard tool). Env: WAKIL_CLIPBOARD_MODE. Note: OSC 52 delivery depends on terminal/tmux support (tmux: set -g set-clipboard on) and cannot be verified by the app.
_comment_context_mode: Long-session mode. context_mode: standard (full conversation sent) | long-session (default — finished requests are collapsed to question + answer, working set archived to the tool cache). context_collapse_min_bytes: turns smaller than this are never collapsed (not worth a note). context_tail_turns: requests older than this many most-recent requests degrade to a single pointer line (archive path + memory key) instead of staying at full size — the soft middle cut that keeps sent context from growing with session length; 0 disables (older requests stay at full size forever). context_tail_answer_bytes: cap on the final answer retained for tail turns; default 0 keeps full answers; a positive value truncates longer answers with an archive pointer appended. context_prune: off (default) | on (model rates each tool round keep/drop/stub; low-value rounds have their tool results stubbed in the projection once projected size exceeds context_prune_at × hard max). context_prune_at: fraction of hard max that triggers pruning (default 0.70). context_prune_target: fraction of hard max pruning aims to reach (default 0.55). context_prune_protect: most recent rounds always kept (default 3). context_prune_at_tokens: absolute trigger in tokens (default 60000; chars = tokens × 4). context_prune_target_tokens: absolute target in tokens (default 40000). Effective trigger = min(at_tokens, at × hard max) — with these defaults a 1M-token backend triggers at 60k tokens even when the fraction never fires, while a 160k backend takes the min. Flag: --context-mode. Env: WAKIL_CONTEXT_MODE. Subagents always run in standard.
_comment_prompt_mode: Split system prompt. prompt_mode: full (default — complete system prompt always loaded) | core (lean preamble with identity + safety gates only; the workflow extension is lazy-loaded as a second system message when the classifier detects a task). Flag: --prompt-mode. Env: WAKIL_PROMPT_MODE. A custom agent_prompt_path bypasses the split (the full file is used).
_comment_subagent_budget: Subagent tool-loop budgets. 0 = use built-in defaults. subagent_max_tool_iterations caps tool round-trips per dispatch (default 40). subagent_turn_tool_budget caps cumulative tool output per dispatch (default 120000, auto-clamped to 35% of active hardMax). subagent_tool_result_cap limits per-result chars (default 12000).
_comment_subagent_budget_class: Per-class subagent budget percentages of the context window. 0 = use built-in defaults (read=40, search=25, edit=60, verify=40). subagents.budget.reserve is held back for the forced final report turn (default 8). Work budget = hardMax * (classPct - reservePct) / 100.
_comment_backend: Proxy backend routing (ilm-proxy only). backend is the default X-Ilm-Backend. external_backends lists names known to route to external/cloud providers (used by the egress consent gate). aux_model pins the proxy's auxiliary model.
_comment_trace: Rich JSONL trace capture for every TUI session. trace_dir defaults to ~/.local/share/wakil/traces.
_comment_misc: agent_prompt_path defaults to agent.txt next to the config file. backend_max_retries caps automatic retries for transient backend failures in unattended runs. stream_idle_timeout_seconds bounds SSE read-idle (0 = default 120s). bg_shell_timeout_seconds bounds notify_on_exit background shell watchdog (0 = default 3600s). mention_base is the base directory for @ file mentions. --think sets the reasoning/thinking effort for the main model (off|none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max); session-scoped, overrides /thinking and config; see /thinking for runtime control.
_comment_skill_creation: Automatic skill creation (deprecated; will be removed in a future release; default off since 0.4.4). mode: off|on|auto|auto-mashura (per-repo /skill-creation setting and per-session override win). Limits are all optional; zero/absent = default.
